titleAr: تنفيذ اللي جهّزه المساعد والتراجع عنه
titleEn: Apply what the assistant prepared, and undo it

undo.note: the engine journals the inverse of every applied change for 24 hours

ar: ازاي اتراجع عن تغيير عمله المساعد؟
ازاي أنفّذ التغيير اللي جهّزه المساعد؟
en: How do I undo a change the assistant made?
The assistant changed something wrong, put it back
How do I apply the change the assistant prepared?

steps: The assistant shows a preview card with the old and new value
In act mode press Apply change; it runs with your own permissions
Press Undo within 24 hours to put it back; if you edited it by hand since, you see the new situation instead
For money, deleting, messages to customers, more than 20 items, price or checkout changes the card shows why it needs a yes; press 'Yes, do it' (single use, 15 minutes) or 'No'
edgeCases: Apply in suggestion mode is refused: the card says so
Changed since the preview: the card is replaced by the fresh one, nothing is written
Money, deletion, customer messages, more than 20 items and checkout-visible changes never apply here: they need the confirmation step
Money, deletion, customer messages, more than 20 items and checkout-visible changes never apply from the Apply button: the card asks for an explicit yes and only that button applies it
Suspended store is read-only: writes fail and the assistant explains
